basic_info.description: Welcome to 2405 23rd St - a sparkling 2bed/2bath jewel box in the heart of the Inner Mission. This charming house offers light-filled living, thoughtfully designed for comfort, connection, and everyday joy. Step inside and be greeted by soaring ceilings and warm bamboo/wood floors that add character throughout, while the open layout flows effortlessly from living to dining to the heart of the home: a stylish kitchen where timeless design meets modern function. With 1 bed on the main level and a spacious ensuite retreat upstairs, there's flexibility for guests, work-from-home, or room to spread out. But the magic doesn't stop there - 2 decks + a south-facing patio invite you outdoors, where sun-soaked afternoons + peaceful evenings await. Think morning coffee on the deck, alfresco dinners under the stars, and a yard that's truly your own slice of serenity. Bonus features: office nook, laundry room, generous storage + 1-car garage. Moments from vibrant 24th St - home to legendary eateries, cool cafs, and local markets. Close to SF General, Potrero Del Sol park, Tartine, Heath Ceramics, and The Morris. Easy access to BART, HWY 101/280 + transit. 2405 23rd St isn't just a home - it's the lifestyle you've been dreaming of, wrapped in classic Victorian charm and soaked in sunshine.
